fields.acceptance: go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/^(run-start|run-start-queue|daemon-settings|daemon-pause|daemon-event-hook|stage-autonomy)$' passes with runs-need-root and root-daemon-lock in force and those scripts unedited (daemon-repo-session is rewritten by root-daemon-rex-session's leaf); a script running rhiza root show in $WORK/repo sees project repo, and in $NOROOT gets exit 2 naming rhiza root init.
fields.statement: The testscript Setup in cmd/rhiza/main_test.go puts every script under a Rhiza root: it makes each script's $WORK its own root, writing $WORK/rhiza.toml that registers a project named repo at $WORK/repo directly (not through rhiza project add), so the existing scripts that start runs, queue requests or run the daemon in the $WORK/repo repo keep passing unedited, and it gives scripts a folder outside any root ($NOROOT) for the outside-a-root cases.
